tasks.label: Test dev: production preview (switch to dev, install, build, serve)
tasks.detail: The release check. Serves the same build that GitHub Pages will publish, on port 4173.

tasks.label: Test dev: dev server (switch to dev, install, hot reload)
tasks.detail: Quick look at dev with hot reload and the PlayCanvas Inspector (backquote key), on port 5173.

tasks.label: Git: switch to latest dev
tasks.detail: Refuses to run with uncommitted changes, then fast-forwards local dev to origin/dev.
tasks.command: if ! git diff --quiet || ! git diff --cached --quiet; then echo 'Uncommitted changes in the working tree: commit or stash them first.'; exit 1; fi; git fetch origin --prune && git switch dev && git pull --ff-only origin dev && git log --oneline -5

tasks.label: Game: serve production preview
tasks.detail: Serves dist/ on port 4173. Stop it with the trash icon in the terminal panel.

tasks.label: Game: dev server
tasks.detail: Hot-reload dev server for the current branch on port 5173.

tasks.label: Ports: print game URLs
tasks.detail: Prints the forwarded Codespaces URLs for the dev server and the preview.
tasks.command: if [ -n "${CODESPACE_NAME:-}" ]; then d="${GITHUB_CODESPACES_PORT_FORWARDING_DOMAIN:-app.github.dev}"; echo "Dev server: https://${CODESPACE_NAME}-5173.${d}/"; echo "Preview:    https://${CODESPACE_NAME}-4173.${d}/"; else echo 'Dev server: http://localhost:5173/'; echo 'Preview:    http://localhost:4173/'; fi

tasks.label: Checks: lint, types, format, unit tests
Checks: end-to-end smoke test
tasks.command: npm run build && npm run test:e2e

tasks.label: Release: show the dev -> master PR
tasks.detail: Shows the open release PR and its CI status. Merge it on GitHub with 'Create a merge commit'.
tasks.command: n=$(gh pr list --base master --head dev --state open --json number --jq '.[0].number'); if [ -z "$n" ]; then echo 'No open release PR from dev to master. Ask the agent to run /release-pr.'; else gh pr view "$n"; echo; gh pr checks "$n" || true; echo; echo "Open in browser: gh pr view $n --web"; fi

tasks.label: Release: tag master after merging
tasks.detail: Run after you merged the release PR. Tags origin/master with the version in package.json.
tasks.command: git fetch origin --prune --tags && v=$(git show origin/master:package.json | node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>console.log(JSON.parse(s).version))") && if git rev-parse -q --verify "refs/tags/v$v" >/dev/null; then echo "Tag v$v already exists: bump the version with '/release-pr cut <version>' first."; exit 1; fi && git tag -a "v$v" origin/master -m "Release v$v" && git push origin "v$v" && echo "Tagged v$v"
